For ChatGPT-based methods, we perform the experiments by calling OpenAI's official API, and the version of ChatGPT we used is gpt-3.5-turbo0301. For hyperparameters such as temperature in the API, we keep the default value of OpenAI unchanged. To reduce randomness, we average results over three random runs for all methods of ChatGPT and baselines.
